hooks.command: filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; for p in .env .env.production composer.lock package-lock.json; do if [[ "$(basename "$filepath")" == "$p" ]]; then echo "BLOCKED: $p is a protected file. Edit manually if needed."; exit 2; fi; done

echo '🔒 STOP GATE — MANDATORY VERIFICATION

Before ending, confirm:
□ All implementation matches the plan (re-read the plan document)
□ All browser test checkpoints passed with snapshots
□ All sub-agent work was verified (not self-approved)
□ No TODO stubs presenting false functionality
□ No console.log left in changed files
□ No hardcoded hex in changed Vue files
□ All user-facing text uses British spelling

If ANY of these are unchecked, address them before stopping.'
